# Pixel Expense Splitter

An offline, single-page browser app to split expenses equally among three friends.

## Features

- Add expenses with payer and amount (in cents).
- View list of expenses with delete option.
- See each person's total paid and net balance (owes or is owed).
- Balances always sum to zero.

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or network required.

## Files

- `index.html` – main page
- `styles.css` – pixel-themed styling
- `app.js` – logic

## Accessibility

- All controls are keyboard accessible and labeled.
- Error messages are announced via `role="alert"`.

## Design

Cohesive palette of dark blue, gold accent, and pastel green/red for balances. Responsive from 360px width.
